U-0005.summary: Make Quoter.QuoteAll's StringReader a using declaration: only the return follows its block, and disposing a StringReader there changes nothing.

U-0008.summary: Make Parcel a record: its Equals compared both fields, which the record's generated Equals does; the constructor with its validation, the properties and GetHashCode stay.
review_notes: Rates.Core targets netstandard2.0, so Parcel stays a record with an explicit constructor rather than a positional one, whose init-only properties need IsExternalInit.

U-0009.summary: Enable nullable reference types in the library and the app: a Quote's Reference and Problem can be null (Problem is, for every priced parcel), and so can the lines TryGetValue and ReadLine give back; nothing else was null.
review_notes: Quote.Reference is null until QuoteLine sets it; it stays nullable rather than gaining a default value, which would change what a new Quote() holds.
